Always use the actual values from the table.

The table below summarises FY25 performance. Figures are unaudited and prepared by management.

| Metric                          | FY25  | Basis     |
|---------------------------------|-------|-----------|
| Annual Recurring Revenue       | $8.4M  | Contracted, annualised |
| Monthly Recurring Revenue      | $700K  | Exit month  |
| Gross margin                   | 78%    | Excl. amortisation |
| EBITDA                          | $1.9M  | Adjusted    |

Adjusted EBITDA reflects add-backs for one-time transaction preparation costs and non-recurring legal expenses.
